items.statement: Once overlap and review quality are accounted for, reviews support at most a short-term improvement in self-reported wellbeing from link worker social prescribing, with low or very low certainty for effects on loneliness, consultation rates and costs.
items.rationale: Matches the pattern in the retrieved reviews; novel in counting primary studies once; feasible with published reviews only.
items.risks: New reviews published during the work; subjective quality judgements.

items.statement: Reviews that include more uncontrolled evaluations reach more positive conclusions.
items.rationale: Testable from the citation matrix; explains why reviews disagree.
